$schema_comment: DRAFT 42-tier pricing ladder scaffold. Crystal must confirm before marketing-live. Do not invent Stripe Price IDs. Universal entitlement: every category gates spend/quota/access through the central entitlement service. On-device privacy applies to ALL 42 tiers. Catalog is open-ended: unknown future platforms register as connectors with a type + meter units. NOTE: AUD ladder from brief had 42 paid prices for a 41-slot paid band (tiers 2–42); 1299 AUD was omitted to keep exactly 42 tiers — Crystal can restore/adjust.

draft_pricing.credit_basis_note: DRAFT: ~1 billable credit ≈ AUD $0.01 platform cost basis — not locked.
draft_pricing.margin_floor_note: DRAFT floor on paid overages (cost + margin). Free has no overages (hard_cap).
draft_pricing.stripe_price_ids: PLACEHOLDER — all stripe_price_id fields are null until Crystal creates Products/Prices.
draft_pricing.privacy_rule: On-device privacy: customer data/workspace stays on their device by default; cloud only when they opt into a connector/inference call. Applies to ALL 42 tiers.
draft_pricing.settlement_rule: Stripe bills the customer into the platform balance. Stripe does NOT pay providers directly. BYOK preferred.
draft_pricing.aud_ladder_note: DRAFT nice-number AUD monthly ladder. Brief listed 42 paid amounts for tiers 2–42 (41 slots); omitted 1299 AUD (kept 139) to keep exactly 42 tiers. Not marketing-live.

creation_platform_catalog.comment: Pluggable registry — Crystal fills connector_id, display_name, capabilities, and billing_mode. Examples of the class (not hardcoded exclusives): Suno (music), CapCut (video edit/export), plus image gen, design tools, voice, etc.

settlement.notes: Stripe collects customer payments into the platform balance. AI providers, creation platforms, social networks, MCP hosts, third-party APIs, and generic connectors bill the platform separately (or the customer via BYOK/app credentials) unless Crystal documents a Stripe Connect relationship with that provider. BYOK / bring-your-own-app-credentials removes platform credit exposure for that connector. Stripe does NOT pay third parties directly by default. DRAFT 42-tier ladder: Stripe bills customer; does NOT pay providers directly. BYOK preferred.
